description.en: Aggregates all web UI components into a single package for comprehensive interface enhancement.

description.en: Offers project management tools for organizing files, tasks, and resources in the desktop workspace.

description.en: Provides structured UI components for building consistent and organized interface elements.
description.zh: 提供结构化 UI 组件，用于构建一致且有序的界面元素。

description.en: 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题，套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图都成了磨砂玻璃片。玻璃模糊度、磨砂度、背景（流体或自定义壁纸，壁纸还能单独调模糊和磨砂）全都能在设置卡片里自由调节。关掉开关就回到原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。

description.en: Turn the whole interface into frosted glass
Composable, view-based memory for DeepSeek Harness. Pluggable sources and strategies, with three-tier memory out of the box.

description.en: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

description.en: Tunnel-mode remote control for dsh web: the plugin adds an in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted mode tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback) with same-origin /dsh-remote relay routes; the desktop bridge and self-hosted relay-router in this repo tunnel local dsh web to a phone browser as an installable PWA with access-key auth, live device list and optional traffic quotas.
description.zh: 隧道模式远程控制 dsh web：插件在设置页新增「远程控制」面板（云端/自建模式切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）并提供同源 /dsh-remote 路由；仓库自带的电脑端 bridge 与自托管 relay-router 构成隧道，把本地 dsh web 以可安装 PWA 形式开放到手机（访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额）。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进飞书的桥接插件：扫码绑定 PersonalAgent、流式卡片、git worktree 项目工作区、scope 并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理，以及 dsh 崩溃后仍在飞书应答的安全网守护。

description.zh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量悬浮框：三窗口（rolling/weekly/monthly）消耗百分比常驻展示，展开为迷你面积图；后台采样官方 /v1/usage 接口，零本地计算。

description.en: Gzip compression for /api responses, fixing history-load timeouts over remote/low-bandwidth connections; skips SSE and already-encoded responses.
description.zh: /api 响应 gzip 压缩，解决远程/低带宽访问时历史加载超时；SSE 与已编码响应自动豁免。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: 原生 DeepSeek Harness 插件形态的代码评审机器人：跨代码平台、规则可插拔、可本地重放。
description.zh: 跨平台代码评审机器人，规则可插拔，还能本地重放，让代码审查更高效灵活。

description.en: 一个 DSH 网页插件，Codex 式侧边聊天的强化版本： 在右侧面板提供按主会话隔离的独立聊天，具备 Codex 式的智能体能力——继承主会话的 工具集、模型、思考难度与权限预设，能感知所在工作目录；选中对话内容即可提问，AI 回复 也能带回主会话（直接带回或摘要后带回，写入草稿或注入为折叠提示行）。  在 Codex 式能力之上，它额外支持：当主会话的智能体弹出问题弹框向你提问时，可以 把问题与各个选项带入侧边聊天、让 AI 帮你分析，不必打断当前流程——想清楚后把答案 带回，再回答弹框即可。
description.zh: 在对话中选中内容，即可在右侧边栏开启独立聊天，针对选中部分提问，不打断主对话。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Preview and move supported Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode setup into DSH, including skills, commands, agents, instructions, and MCP servers, with OpenCode V1/V2 JSONC support and collision-safe apply.
description.zh: 一键把 Claude Code 的技能、MCP、钩子和指令整体迁移到 DSH，拎包入住无缝衔接。

description.en: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码结构分析工具，快速定位符号声明、调用关系及变更影响范围。

description.en: Web UI polish layer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between insta…
description.zh: untranslated
